cases.title: Capability enabled/disabled 展示。
covered_dimensions: Retained the five previously reviewed protected Native Node enabled-capability samples and UI matches from batch22.
Attempted only the exact grant03 Node ID after Recovery provided it; actual GET /api/nodes/:id returned 404 before any capability sample or UI section was available.
remaining_dimensions: No actual false capability boolean or Disabled badge was observed for the granted Node because it was already absent (GET404) when the read-only probe ran. Do not infer false from missing/nil capabilities and do not inspect another Node.
cases.interpretation: The missing Node was not treated as a false-capability sample. Recovery cleanup was not delayed and no fallback Node was inspected.
